blocks.text: Esi sitatimende sisebenza ngokufanayo kwizinto zemidiya yesithathu ezisetyenziselwa ukubonisa, ukusebenzisana okanye ukuhlobisa kwiwebhusayithi ye-OmniCivitas kunye nekhowudi yokugcina ikhowudi ye-GitHub, kubandakanywa nemifanekiso, i-emoticons, i-GIFs, imifanekiso, iikliphu zevidiyo, umculo, iziphumo zesandi, amazwi kunye nomxholo wesibini ohambelanayo.

Amalungelo okukhuphela, amalungelo ophawu lwentengiso, amalungelo abadlali, amalungelo abavelisi beaudio kunye neevidiyo ababandakanyekayo kwezi zinto zingentla, kunye nomfanekiso, igama, ilizwi kunye namanye amalungelo anxulumeneyo kunye nezinto ezinomdla ezibonwa ngumthetho, ngabanini bamalungelo abo ngokulandelelana. Le projekthi ayifumani malungelo kwimathiriyeli yokuqala ngenxa yokuqokelela, ukuboniswa, ukucinezelwa, ukunqunyulwa kwemveliso, ukuguqulwa kwamagama okanye enye inkqubo; amalungelo asanda kongezwa ngokuhambelana nomthetho kwisiqulatho sokusetyenzwa kwesibini asithathi indawo yamalungelo ezinto zokuqala.

Ezinye izinto zivela ekuhanjisweni kwexesha elide lothungelwano, kwaye umshicileli wabo wokuqala, umbhali, iprosesa okanye ikhonkco lobunini elipheleleyo alinakuqinisekiswa ngokuthembekileyo. Le projekthi ayibangi izinto ezingaziwayo njengemvelaphi, ilayisensi, okanye kwindawo yoluntu. Inyaniso yokuba imathiriyeli isasazwa ngokubanzi, inesisombululo esisezantsi, kwaye iye yaveliswa kaninzi ayithethi ukuba amalungelo afanelekileyo aphelelwe lixesha.

Le projekthi ngumfuniselo wetekhnoloji yomntu ongenzi nzuzo kunye nomboniso wokuzonwabisa. Inkangeleko yemathiriyeli ayithethi ukuba abanini-malungelo abafanelekileyo, iinkampani, imisebenzi, iimpawu okanye abalinganiswa kwizixhobo bathatha inxaxheba, baxhasa, baxhasa okanye baxhasa le projekthi, kwaye akuthethi ukuba le projekthi inobudlelwane obusemthethweni bentsebenziswano kunye nabo. Injongo yokusetyenziswa komdlalo ohlekisayo, ukusetyenzwa okwesibini okanye iinjongo ezingenzi nzuzo ayithethi ukuba imvume ifunyenwe okanye ngokuqinisekileyo ithobelana nemiqathango yokusetyenziswa kwimithetho esebenzayo.
Ilayisensi yekhowudi kunye nemida yezinto eziphathekayo

Imiqathango yokusetyenziswa kwekhowudi yomthombo ixhomekeke kwi-LICENSE kwindawo yokugcina impahla kunye nenkcazo yelayisensi yefayile ehambelanayo. Nokuba ikhowudi yeprojekthi ithatha ilayisensi ye-MIT, ilayisenisi ayifaki ngokuzenzekelayo imifanekiso yomntu wesithathu, ii-GIF, iaudio kunye nevidiyo, iimpawu zokuthengisa okanye ezinye izinto zemidiya. Ikhowudi yomntu wesithathu ixhomekeke kwiilayisensi zabo.

Le projekthi ayiniki abasebenzisi imvume yokukopa, ukulungelelanisa, ukusasaza okanye ukuthengisa izixhobo zomntu wesithathu ngale ngxelo. Apho kukho ilayisenisi esemthethweni eyahlukileyo okanye isigunyaziso sezinto eziphathekayo, elo phepha-mvume okanye ugunyaziso luya kulawula; le ngxelo ayithathi ndawo, iyandise okanye iyirhoxise. Ukuvala indawo yokugcina, ukukhuphela iifayile okanye ukuhambisa iwebhusayithi akuthethi ukuba ufumene ilungelo lokusebenzisa izixhobo zemidiya.

Xa umnini wamalungelo okanye i-arhente yakhe egunyazisiweyo ekholelwa ukuba izinto ezikule projekthi zibandakanya amalungelo akhe kunye nezinto anomdla kuzo, unokubonelela ngengxelo ngoMbaliso kwindawo yokugcina i-GitHub yale projekthi okanye ngokusebenzisa iziteshi zoqhagamshelwano ezivezwe ngumgcini. Ukuququzelela indawo kunye nokuqinisekisa, nceda uchaze amaphepha afanelekileyo, iifayile okanye izixhobo, amalungelo okubangwayo, ubunini obuqinisekisiweyo okanye isiseko se-arhente, kunye nendlela yokucubungula efunwayo.

Nceda ungafaki iinkcukacha zakho ezibuthathaka ezifana nezazisi, idilesi, inombolo yomnxeba, njl.njl. kwimiba yoluntu; xa ufuna ukungenisa isatifikethi esingesiso esasesidlangalaleni, nceda uqale ucele umlondolozi ukuba akubonelele ngejelo loqhagamshelwano labucala. Le projekthi ayiyi kunqaba ukuqinisekisa amabango afanelekileyo asekelwe "kujikelezo lwe-intanethi" okanye le nkcazo, kwaye iya kuthatha ukumiswa kokubonisa, ukutshintshwa, ukucima okanye amanye amanyathelo ayimfuneko ngokusekelwe kwimeko yokuqinisekisa kunye nemithetho esebenzayo.

Le nkcazo isetyenziselwa ukuchaza imida yamalungelo kunye neendlela zempendulo zemathiriyeli. Ayiloxwebhu logunyaziso oluvela kumnini wamalungelo, kwaye ayikokuzibophelela ekukhululweni kubutyala obusemthethweni. Abagcini bathwala uxanduva oluhambelanayo lokusetyenziswa kwabo, ukubonisa kunye nokusasazwa ngokuhambelana nomthetho; amalungelo athile kunye nezibophelelo zamaqela achaphazelekayo zixhomekeke kwimithetho esebenzayo, iilayisensi ezisemthethweni kunye neemeko ezichanekileyo. Le nkcazo ayithinteli okanye ithintele abanini bamalungelo ukuba bafune amalungelo abo ngokuhambelana nomthetho, okanye ukucinywa okulandelayo, ukutshintshwa okanye ukususwa kwiishelufu ngokuzenzekelayo kuphelisa iimfanelo ezisemthethweni eziye zavela.
